summary: GRN Fase 1 refactor validated. Ran /app/backend/tests/test_inbound_complete_characterization.py (2 tests, scan-label + manual-rolls paths) — BOTH PASS with GOLDEN fingerprints exactly matching (task_status=qc_pending, qty_rolls=2, rolls list, po_received_delta, po_status, je_count/je_debit, lots). test_grn_phase0.py 12/12 PASS. test_wms_advance_expected.py 2/2 PASS. Sequential run: 16/16 pass. Parallel xdist showed 1 transient flake (test_block_over_remaining_changes_scan_label DELETE returned 400 due to concurrent worker touching the same task doc) — passes cleanly when serial; not a refactor regression. Zero residue verified: no wms_char_*/wms_grn0_* tasks, no rolls with dye_lot DL-CH/DL-M1/DL-GRN0. Scan-label API behaviour probe (new test /app/backend/tests/test_iter65_scan_label_probe.py) exercises PO inbound task for prod_batik_mega (CBN-MEGA-PREM): 200 OK for valid raw with roll status=receiving + declared_length=50 + rfid_epc field present in response; 409 on duplicate roll no; 400 OVER_PO for qty far above line qty; 400 UNMAPPED for unknown supplier code; task advanced to receiving with received_qty>=50; cleanup via DELETE /inbound/rolls/{id}/scan + task doc restore leaves zero residue. Frontend smoke (?view=operations&entity=ent_ksc as warehouse@): Barang Masuk tab renders 15 inbound tasks, panel opens on task click, ZERO console errors.

minor.issue: Transient parallel-run flake under pytest-xdist loadscope — DELETE /inbound/rolls/{rid}/scan returns 400 when a sibling worker mutates the shared inbound task concurrently. Passes cleanly serial. Consider marking with @pytest.mark.serial or scoping to a synth task like the characterization suite does.

action_items: (Optional) Refactor test_grn_phase0.py::test_block_over_remaining_changes_scan_label to clone the seed task (like the characterization suite) so parallel xdist workers don't collide on the same task doc during scan/DELETE.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is behaviour-preserving: characterization golden fingerprints match exactly on both scan-label and manual-rolls paths (rolls, PO deltas, GL, lots, task status all bit-for-bit).
services/receiving_roll_service.py exposes both create_label_roll (wired) and create_counted_roll (prepared, not wired) — matches Phase 1 scope.
receiving_roll_service.create_label_roll sets roll_doc['rfid_epc']='' when auto_rfid_on_scan is off; the field is always emitted on API response — good for FE contract stability.
Router inbound_receiving.py 'complete' is a thin wrapper over services/inbound_complete_service.complete_task(task_id, payload, actor, *, ctx=None, via_grn=None) per spec.
